answer.reason: Several verses tell deeds of Michal beyond the relations in the summary: saving David, being taken from Phaltiel, and despising David at the ark.

clauses.english: let David down through a window so he escaped Saul's messengers
clauses.quote: So Michal let David down through a window

clauses.english: was taken from her husband Phaltiel at David's demand
clauses.quote: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband

clauses.english: despised David in her heart as he danced before the ark of the LORD
clauses.quote: saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart

doubts: 2SA 21:8 names five sons of Michal brought up for Adriel; this is likely a different woman (Merab, Adriel's wife) and was left out.
1CH 15:29 repeats the scene of 2SA 6:16 and was not cited separately.
Her love for David (1SA 18:20) and her childlessness (2SA 6:23) were left out as minor or already shown in the summary.
